text: Sri Venkateswara Boys' Hostel · Plumbing & Utilities Manual · 2019 edition, with 2024 revisions at the back. Keep in the pump room. Do not take home.

Index. Safety rules p.3 · Pump room and motor timings p.8-12 · Overhead tanks and cleaning p.15-18 · Valve junction and lever colours p.41-44 · Revision 2024 (C-block renovation) p.44 · Electrical panel p.50-53 · Fire hydrant line p.60 · Kitchen LPG manifold p.70 · Emergency contacts p.90.
Never work alone at night on electrical or gas equipment. Water and electricity: switch off the panel before mopping near sockets. Report every leak to the warden, even small ones.
Wear rubber slippers in the pump room. The floor near the motor is always wet. Keep the pump room locked; the key is with the security desk.
The main motor fills the overhead tanks twice a day: 5:30 am and 6:00 pm, about 40 minutes each run. Do not run the motor when a main line is shut.
If the motor makes a grinding noise, switch it off at panel P2 and inform the warden. Spare fuses are in the red box on the left wall.
Borewell motor and municipal supply both feed the sump. Municipal water arrives on Tuesdays and Fridays, early morning.
Monthly check: grease the motor bearings, check the foot valve, note the meter reading in the blue register.
Each block has two 5,000-litre tanks on the terrace. Tanks are cleaned every three months by an outside agency.
Before cleaning a tank, shut that block's lever at the valve junction and inform the students one day earlier.
Overflowing tank: switch off the motor first, then check the float valve on the terrace.

Valve junction: behind the pump room, ground floor. Levers are colour-coded. A lever lying ALONG the pipe is open; turn it a quarter turn so it lies ACROSS the pipe to shut. Use the 24 mm wrench hanging on the wall if a lever is stiff.
RED lever: MAIN INLET. Shuts water to EVERY block, the kitchen and the RO drinking-water plant. Never shut the red lever without the warden's approval.
BLUE lever: A-block, all floors. GREEN lever: B-block, all floors.
YELLOW lever: C-block, all bathrooms on all floors (2019 layout).
WHITE lever: RO drinking-water plant only. BLACK-handled wheel: fire hydrant line. NEVER shut the fire hydrant line.
If you cannot tell which lever is which, do not guess. Call the warden. Shutting the wrong line can stop drinking water or the fire line.

Revision 2024, after the C-block renovation: the C-block 2nd-floor bathrooms now have their own ORANGE lever. Shutting ORANGE stops water to the 2nd-floor bathrooms only. YELLOW still shuts all of C-block.
After a leak is repaired, open the lever slowly and check the repaired joint for drips for five minutes.
Panel P1: hostel lighting. Panel P2: motors. Panel P3: kitchen. Only the electrician or the warden may switch off P1 or P3.
If water reaches a socket or a switch board, switch off that floor's MCB at the floor distribution board before anyone touches it.
The fire hydrant line must always stay open and pressurised. It is checked every month by the fire officer.
The grey wheel in the kitchen is the LPG gas manifold. It is NOT a water valve. Only the cook or the warden may touch it.
Smell of gas: do not switch any light on or off, open windows, shut the grey wheel, call the warden.
The mess needs water from 5 am. Shutting the main line before 7 am stops breakfast.
Washing machines in the C-block ground floor take water from the C-block line (yellow).
Warden, deputy warden and plumber numbers are kept at the security desk and in the hostel helpdesk system, not in this manual, because they change every year.
